causes: Successful logins consumed the five-attempt account and twenty-attempt source-IP budgets.
Expired or replaced ten-minute login cookies produced raw JSON at the browser callback.
change: Successful password and MFA-prompt responses no longer consume failed-login budgets. Browser callback failures retain denial and offer an explicit fresh-login link; JSON callers retain JSON errors.
limits: The owner's full password login in production was not performed. Actual successful logins were verified with isolated credentials and PostgreSQL, and Chrome used isolated credential fixtures.
The existing unrelated OpenBao secret-synchronization outage remains outside this repair.
